fields.note: Builder is a party; role maps to applicant only after local confirmation.
Address identifies the application; ORI carries an application IRI, not the address.
A signature date is the sender's assertion time, not receipt.
Each certified item becomes an information item; an unanswered item is unknown, never fail.
Warranty terms are outside the four records; future work.
Inspection is a separate future record; nearest neutral role only.
